title: Sree Vidyanikethan International School Tirupati Wins Third Place at CBSE National Basketball Championship
summary: The U-14 Boys team of Sree Vidyanikethan International School, Tirupati, finished third at the CBSE National-Level Basketball Championship held at St. Xavier’s School, Bathinda.
body_html:
Tirupati, 10 November 2026: Sree Vidyanikethan International School (SVIS), Tirupati, has secured third position in the U-14 Boys category at the CBSE National-Level Basketball Championship. The school’s team competed against 20 top-performing schools from across the country and finished among the top three in its category.

The championship was organised by St. Xavier’s School, Bathinda, Punjab, under the aegis of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). The event brought together young basketball players from schools across India, with teams first competing in a league stage before the leading sides moved on to the knockout rounds.

The SVIS team performed consistently in the league stage, winning four of its five matches. This record placed the team as runners-up in its group and earned it a place in the knockout rounds. The players continued to perform strongly in the later stages of the tournament, showing resilience and determination, and went on to finish third in the U-14 Boys category.

According to the school, the team’s performance reflected the discipline, teamwork and competitive spirit that it seeks to build through its approach to holistic education. SVIS was founded by Padma Shri Dr. M. Mohan Babu, actor, educationist and founder-chairman of the Sri Vidyanikethan Educational Trust.

Commenting on the achievement, Vinay Maheshwari, Trustee, Sree Vidyanikethan Educational Trust, said, “Securing third position at the CBSE National-Level Basketball Championship is a proud moment for the entire state of Andhra Pradesh. This achievement reflects our commitment to providing students with opportunities to discover their potential, build confidence, and learn the value of perseverance through sport. We congratulate the team of Sree Vidyanikethan International School, Tirupati, the coaches, and everyone who contributed to this accomplishment.”

The third-place finish rounds off a campaign in which the Tirupati school’s U-14 Boys team won four league matches against schools from across the country before progressing through the knockout rounds of the CBSE national championship in Bathinda.
